title: Financial Times names Incorruptible to Best Summer Books of 2026 (Business) — Oxford Saïd Bodleian display
summary: The Financial Times named Incorruptible to its Best Summer Books of 2026 in the Business category. Oxford's Sainsbury Library, the Bodleian's business library at Saïd Business School, put the whole list on display in its Lower Reading Room.
blockquote: Including wide-ranging examples such as Cadbury, John Lewis Partnership, Vanguard and Anthropic, Incorruptible uncovers the urgent need for purpose-driven leadership. It gives every builder, founder, executive, investor or citizen the tools to create enterprises that uplift rather than exploit.
blockquote_source: Sainsbury Library (Bodleian Libraries, Oxford Saïd Business School)
